text: The research saves Shirley N. Weber as the strongest candidate for California Secretary of State. CAIR Action endorsed Weber, and Vote for Peace recorded her as supported at the Ally tier. On October 12, 2023, Weber condemned the attack on Israel while expressing sympathy for both Israeli and Palestinian civilians, calling for an end to the conflict and addressing its underlying causes. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive, and secure Jewish state, endorsed Weber in the primary, a carry-forward reflected for the November general. Her Republican opponent, Donald P. Wagner, was rated Opposed by Vote for Peace.
